messages.content:
Our return policy is as follows:

* You can modify your order within 1 hour of placing it. Contact our support team with your order number.
* We offer price matching on identical items from authorized retailers. Contact us with proof of the lower price.
* If you need to return an item, please contact our support team and we'll guide you through the process.

Please note that our business hours are Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM EST. You can reach us through chat, email (support@store.com), or phone (1-800-SUPPORT).

If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to ask!
